Summary:
We're looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Scheduling Coordinator to provide essential after-hours scheduling and operational support for our field nursing and clinical teams. This remote position is crucial for ensuring the timely and efficient scheduling of patient visits, enabling our clinicians to optimize their patient interactions and deliver high-quality home healthcare. You'll play a direct role in the seamless delivery of care by expertly managing visit logistics and supporting our field staff.
 
Responsibilities:
Assign visits and complete associated scheduling tasks within the HomeCare HomeBase (HCHB) EMR system to support field clinicians.
Monitor EMR workflows to ensure timely documentation and progress of patient care tasks related to scheduling.
Prioritize and triage incoming scheduling requests based on urgency and patient care needs.
Effectively communicate and collaborate with triage and field clinicians regarding visit assignments and schedule adjustments.
Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously in an organized work environment, managing a dynamic scheduling caseload.
Respond to user requests for scheduling assistance, completing tasks timely, accurately, and efficiently.
Escalate unresolved or critical scheduling issues to leadership when appropriate.
Maintain productivity standards and participate in meetings or training sessions.
Demonstrate reliable attendance and adherence to assigned shifts.
Candidates must be available to work weekends and holidays, as scheduling needs dictate. Flexibility is needed to fill in shifts and cover PTO. 
Other Duties as assigned
